goal: One birth-time raw reasoning block plus the context visible at that birth -> generated shorter reasoning -> continuation by the original receiver.

input.raw: Exact reasoning block; do not concatenate separate births or truncate silently.
input.ctx: Exact compressor-visible context snapshot; distinguish it from the full receiver conversation and record truncation/assembly policy.
input.allowedGrounding: Facts already in visible ctx may ground the draft; retaining ctx does not require repeating its entire ledger in the draft.
input.temporalBoundary: No subsequent tool result, edit confirmation, reader outcome, or future-turn solution is allowed in raw/ctx/reference.
input.instructionsInRaw: Source material, not instructions to the compressor.
input.mutations: No hidden case folding, normalization, source substitution or current-prompt relabelling. UTF-16 spans address the retained text.

forbidden: promote a hypothesis to verified fact
resolve a source contradiction by guesswork
claim a planned edit/test already happened
change target tasks or usable tool names
force shorter output when material information cannot fit

requiredLayers: complete AI single-reviewer source facts and draft claims
dimensions: all-input net token and cost savings
quality.thresholdPolicy: Deployment thresholds require user resource budgets and a new frozen evaluator; historical v9 stays INVALID.

data.auxiliarySources: Keep off-target until separately preregistered target-heldout transfer is demonstrated.
data.syntheticControls: Apparatus/coverage probes only, never admitted target traces or proof of arbitrary-CoT capability.

executionOrder: task contract and actual readback observability
small fully reviewed developer references and length ladder
parallelEarlyWork: Cheap CPU/tokenizer hard-feasibility checks may run early after machine/resource authorization, but cannot prove the task valuable or the supervision correct.
